objective: Theorem with proof: for a cubic glue and two signings in one switching class, the plain edge-atom spaces give the same native creation verdict (order-free far-side vector, or degenerate) at every glue line after removing any other glue line. Finite lemma on the edge atom checked exhaustively; the reduction to the signed glue and the invariance under switching cross-checked on the 22 computed placements and on random switchings.
status: Proved: for every cubic glue and every two signings in one switching class, removing a glue line and gluing at a glue line gives the same native creation verdict in the plain edge-atom spaces (an edge atom's inner points take part in no knot the two-round rule uses, so creation between glue lines is creation in the signed glue, and switching only complements points); finite atom lemma exhaustive; cross-checked on 22 placements (3,500 entries) and 136 random switchings
title: Creation between glue lines depends only on the switching class
